methodology.coordinator: seed_ancestors >= 3 AND in_degree >= 3 AND out_degree >= 2 AND betweenness > 0
methodology.transit: NOT is_seed AND NOT boundary_censored AND in_degree > 0 AND out_degree > 0 AND 0.8 <= pass_through <= 1.2
methodology.terminal: NOT is_seed AND NOT boundary_censored AND in_sum > 0 AND pass_through <= 0.2
methodology.peripheral: No preceding rule matched; insufficient structural evidence, including isolates
methodology.scores: role_score is rule strength, not a calibrated probability; priority is structural review importance, not guilt
methodology.community: Louvain on undirected projection: w(u,v)=sum_kzt(u,v)+sum_kzt(v,u), positive weights, resolution=1, seed=42; singleton isolates; cluster ids ordered by minimum numeric gid
methodology.centrality: Directed unweighted normalized betweenness; k=min(128,n), seed=42; monetary amounts are strengths, not shortest-path distances
methodology.seed_ancestors: Number of distinct other seed nodes with a directed path to this node; excludes the node itself; not an allegation
